calendar.title: Calendar subscriptions
calendar.description: Put your DiveDay departures on the calendar you already use. Subscribing is read-only: DiveDay never reads or changes anything in your calendar.
calendar.refreshNote: Your calendar decides how often it re-reads the feed — usually within a few hours, not instantly. Treat DiveDay as the source of truth for a same-day change.

assignments.name: My departures
assignments.detail: Every trip you are assigned to crew, teach, or captain.

shopTrips.name: All shop departures
shopTrips.detail: Every scheduled departure at this shop, whoever is crewing it.

status.neverRead: No calendar has read it yet — paste the link into one to finish.

actions.confirmRotate: Replace this link? Any calendar still using the old one stops updating.
actions.confirmTurnOff: Turn off this subscription? The link stops working immediately.

newLink.heading: Your subscription link
newLink.shownOnce: Copy this now — for your security it is shown once. If you lose it, replace the link to get a new one.
newLink.webcalHint: Opens your calendar app and subscribes.

warning.rotate: Replacing the link stops the old one working right away. Any calendar still using it will quietly stop updating until you paste the new link in.
warning.shared: Anyone with this link can read these departures without signing in. Treat it like a password.

notice.denied: You do not have access to that calendar scope.

calendar.coverage: Covers departures from {past} days ago through {future} days ahead.

staffing.title: Staffing
staffing.description: See who is working, what each person is qualified to teach or crew, and where the next boat still has a coverage gap.

working.heading: Who is working
working.managerOnly: Shift changes require owner or manager

addShift.heading: Add a working shift
addShift.detail: A shift says when someone is available. Assign the actual crew on each trip separately.

coverage.heading: Coverage gaps
coverage.detail: These are prompts to resolve before the manifest becomes a dock-side surprise.
coverage.noTrips: No scheduled trips in this window.
coverage.allGood: Crew is assigned, and their shift covers this trip.

gap.no_shift_coverage: No working shift covers this trip

notice.overlap: That person already has an overlapping shift.
notice.staffNotFound: That staff member is no longer on this shop's team.
notice.invalid: Check the shift date and times, then try again.
notice.notAuthorized: Only owners and managers can change shifts.

blockers.title: Blockers

description.none: Everyone booked on an upcoming departure is ready to board.
description.some: {blocked, plural, one {# diver} other {# divers}} across {departures, plural, one {# departure} other {# departures}} can't board yet. Clearing a row takes you straight to the fix.

blockers.alsoBlockedOn: Also blocked on {trips} — same diver, fix once.
blockers.sendAllWaivers: {count, plural, one {Send all # waiver} other {Send all # waivers}}
blockers.emptyDescription: No upcoming diver is waiting on a waiver, a card, or a payment. New bookings show up here the moment something needs a hand.
blockers.truncated: Showing the nearest 40 departures. Anything further out lives on the <link>schedule</link>.

checkIn.title: Line-busting check-in
checkIn.description: Scan a booking code or search a diver, confirm live readiness, and keep the line moving. Check-in is arrival status; boarding is still confirmed on the manifest.
checkIn.todaysDepartures: Today’s departures and the next boat.
checkIn.emptyDescription: Try the diver’s name, email, or full booking ID.

search.label: Scan or search diver
search.hint: A barcode scanner can type a booking ID here.

notice.checkedIn: Diver checked in. Next diver is ready when you are.
notice.alreadyCheckedIn: That diver is already checked in.
notice.notReady: Readiness changed — resolve the blocker before checking them in.
notice.notBookable: That booking is no longer available for check-in.
notice.notFound: That booking could not be found.
notice.staffNotFound: Your staff access could not be confirmed.
notice.invalid: Choose a diver from the queue before checking in.

waiversStaff.title: Waiver
waiversStaff.description: Every diver signs this one release. Edit it to fit your shop.

banner.savedFirst: Your waiver is saved. Every future edit is kept as a new version.
banner.invalid: That didn't save. The release needs to be at least a few sentences long.

waiversStaff.placeholder: Write the release the diver will read and sign.

releaseDescription.current: This is the release every new link sends. Saving replaces it for new links — waivers already signed keep the exact text they were signed against.
releaseDescription.sample: This is sample wording to start from — edit it to fit your shop, and have your own counsel review it.

waiversStaff.integrityDescription: New signed records carry a server-sealed HMAC over their signed metadata and template snapshot. A mismatch is an audit stop; older imported or legacy records are clearly marked unsealed.
waiversStaff.truncatedNotice: Showing the 20 most recent signed records. To view the complete history, use the CSV export.

createdNotice.series: “{title}” is on the board — {count, plural, one {# trip} other {# trips}} scheduled. 🤙

shopHome.demoReset: Demo data reset — fresh boat, clean slate. 🤿
shopHome.emailFailed: That email still couldn’t be sent — check the address and email configuration.
shopHome.noDeparturesEmpty: Nothing is on the books yet. Schedule a trip and it will show up here the morning it sails.
